answer: Each identity locks a 14 POA bond for 15 epochs and publishes a lantern commitment to its funding parent. Every violet checkpoint assigns 7 random established auditors; 5 must verify signed work receipts and parent links. For the kth linked identity, the bond is 14*2^(k-1) POA, so each extra fake doubles marginal cost. The wander registry records proofs; a mismatch slashes the cluster and blocks it for 10 epochs.
